evals.prompt: Install RichViz into this static site. It already has Chart.js and a restrictive CSP; use local assets and keep its article viewer lazy.
evals.expected_output: Audits existing setup, reuses Chart.js, identifies required CSP/local paths, applies narrow lazy integration, validates and reports tests.

evals.prompt: Upgrade our React Flow diagrams to the latest Rich Viz but don't disturb other diagrams or the shared React runtime.
evals.expected_output: Routes to richviz-updater, which audits the existing integration, maps paths and adaptations, plans a differential update, and preserves the shared runtime.

evals.prompt: Remove RichViz because we don't use the gallery anymore.
evals.expected_output: Searches imports, specs/fences, runtime references, vendor consumers and saved content; removes only proven-unused owned files and retains required data/dependencies.
